name: Rogues' Castle (Wilderness)
accessNote: Rogue spawns across the floors of Rogues' Castle in the deep north-east Wilderness (~level 50+). Krystilia only counts Wilderness kills. The Chaos Elemental roams the courtyard and can attack through walls. Multicombat, cannon and safespot are not wiki-stated for this spot; conservative defaults are used. Deep-Wilderness PKer risk is high.
